name: Governed Scale Assurance Execution and Disclosure Control
objective: Execute independent-review-ready controls and govern climate/ESG disclosure promotion so claims remain traceable to defined evidence populations, periods, methodologies and authorized conclusions.

climate_esg.ifrs_s2: Governance, strategy, risk management, metrics and targets; materiality and applicable jurisdiction determine disclosure.
climate_esg.ghg_protocol: Organizational/operational boundaries, Scope 1/2/3, activity data, emission factors, methods, period and change control.
climate_esg.esrs_e1: Applicable adopted ESRS version, reporting perimeter and effective period; retain impact and financial materiality distinctly where applicable.

fail_closed: claim exceeds reviewed scope or period
independent conclusion absent or out of scope
public surface differs from authorized record
